text:
kai (recruiter): Quick coordination for candidate Diego Rios (L3 SRE). Wants a half-day onsite on Mon; needs to catch a 4pm ferry, so earliest start is 09:30 and must leave by 14:30. Also requested a silent room for the troubleshooting exercise and a nearby parking spot.

neel (hiring mgr): We can compress loop. Proposed: 09:30 remote screen (30m), 10:15 onsite troubleshooting (60m), 12:00 onsite panel (60m). That finishes by 13:15 leaving buffer before 14:30. Can interviewers keep debriefs to 10m?

mira (people-ops): Sounds good. We'll reserve a quiet conference (Conf G) and visitor parking spot V14 from 09:00-15:00. Adding a 15m buffer after the onsite for candidate to collect belongings.

it-support-bot: For troubleshooting exercise, we can set up an isolated VM and a silent room with headset. Loaner laptop ready as backup. Please confirm candidate prefers company VM or own laptop.

kai (recruiter): Diego will use his laptop but wants the company VM available. He also asked for transit reimbursement for the ferry pickup (since he is taking car+ferry). We'll cover reasonable expense; ask him to submit receipt.

facilities-bot: Conf G (north quiet wing) reserved 10:00-13:30. We'll disable overhead announcements during the session and place a "Quiet Interview" sign. Visitor parking V14 reserved per Mira. Front desk will pre-print badge.

mira (people-ops): I've added note to calendar invite: "Candidate needs to leave by 14:30 for ferry. Please keep debriefs to 10m; no recordings." Also attached expense instructions and ferry reimbursement policy link.

neel (hiring mgr): Please add Zoom fallback and include the VM access instructions in the invite. Interviewers: I'll ask you to be punctual so we can respect Diego's departure time.

kai (recruiter): Diego confirmed the schedule and said he'll bring ferry ticket receipts. Invites sent for 2027-01-11 09:30-10:00 remote, 10:15-11:15 onsite (troubleshoot), 12:00-13:00 panel. Thanks all :)

mira (people-ops): Final checklist in invite: Conf G reserved, V14 parking, VM sandbox available, loaner laptop backup, expense instructions added, 15m buffer before 14:30. Closing thread 1: reopen if travel changes.
